department: Schulich School of Engineering, Department of Electrical and Software Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by January 31, 2027 for September 2027 entry. Year inferred.

gre_general.value: The program lists no required test scores, so the GRE is not needed.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE exists for engineering.

supervisor.value: You need a supervisor during the PhD, but not one before you start.
supervisor.quote: A supervisor is required, but is not required prior to the start of the program

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student is guaranteed at least CAD 33,205 a year (international; CAD 31,426 domestic) for the first four years, if progress stays satisfactory.
funding.quote: Full-time PhD students beginning their program on or after January 1, 2026, are guaranteed a minimum funding package of $31,426 for domestic students and $33,205 for international students. | These annual amounts are guaranteed for the first four years of a PhD program

entry_route.value: An MSc is required; the Schulich School admits from a BSc only in exceptional cases or by transfer from the MSc.
entry_route.quote: MSc degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or software engineering.
